_readme: Every player-facing string in the SKATE client, by slot id. games/skate.html references strings ONLY by these ids -- never a literal. QUILL owns tone-lock: encouraging, concrete, no hype-slogan language ('EPIC', 'LEGENDARY', exclamation-point stacking). Money copy follows the same honest-ledger register as public/pricing.html elsewhere in this repo: say exactly what something costs and what it isn't, never oversell. LAW: 'trophy, not investment; Sparks, never cash' -- no string anywhere may imply cash-out, investment return, or guaranteed value.

portal.hub_tagline: Nine spots. Blind picks. Every attempt films.

hub.roster_sub: Cosmetic only for now -- every rider plays identically until boards and decals unlock.
hub.spot_locked: Locked -- unlocks on a streak day

buy_in.insufficient: You need {amount} Sparks to skate this table -- top up in the shop.

pick_toast.locked_in: Locked in. Waiting on the other rider…
pick_toast.waiting_opponent: Your pick is in. They're still deciding.

reveal.same_style: Same style -- you both ride it clean.
reveal.you_win_clash: Your style takes it. They bail.
reveal.you_lose_clash: Their style takes it. You bail.

render_hud.filming: Filming it now—pick your next trick (ETA ~{eta}s)
render_hud.clip_failed: Clip didn't render -- your instant replay still counts
render_hud.fuel_empty: Out of fuel for real clips today -- still playing on instant replay, free, no limit.

match_result.lose_sub: You spelled the full word first.
match_result.push_sub: Ran out of spots, even letters -- nobody spelled it.

streak_unlocks.day1: Day 1 streak -- a new board decal is yours.
streak_unlocks.day3: Day 3 streak -- a new trick style variant unlocked.
streak_unlocks.day7: Day 7 streak -- a new spot is open.

errors.generic: Something didn't load right. Try again in a moment.
errors.match_not_found: Couldn't find that match -- it may have ended.
errors.already_picked: You already locked in this round.

wallet_consent.connect_prompt: Connect a wallet? Optional -- guests can skate under this session's identity.
wallet_consent.consent_note: SHADDAI never sees your private key. You sign, we never hold custody.
wallet_consent.no_embed_note: Wallet connect only happens on the world/dashboard page, never inside an embedded match.

nft_founder.earned_only_note: Founder boards are earned, not bought -- won by placing in a Canyon Cup.
nft_founder.soulbound_note: A founder board is yours alone -- it doesn't trade, sell, or transfer.
nft_founder.not_investment_note: This is a trophy, not an investment. It pays out nothing and represents no financial return.
nft_founder.mint_confirm: Mint your Canyon Cup founder board?
